attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "HIRECT receives a letter of acceptance for Appx. ₹ 136.26 Crore Order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for 900 Traction Motors for WAG-9 Electric Locomotives".
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited received a letter of acceptance for an order valued at approximately Rs. 136.26 crore from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works. The order is for the supply of 900 three-phase asynchronous traction motors for WAG-9 electric locomotives. Supplies are scheduled to be executed in a phased manner between January 2027 and December 2027. The order includes a warranty period of 78 months from the date of delivery. This announcement was made via a press release dated November 18, 2026. The company is formerly known as Hind Rectifiers Limited.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited has released the transcript of the earnings conference call held on November 11, 2026. The call discussed financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27. The transcript is available on the company website at https://hirect.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Transcript.pdf. This submission is made pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Hirect receives a letter of acceptance for Appx. ₹133.38 Crore Order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for IGBT-Based Propulsion Systems ".
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited received a letter of acceptance for an order valued at approximately 133.38 crore rupees from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works. The order is for the supply of 78 sets of IGBT-based 3-phase drive propulsion equipment. Deliveries are scheduled between April 2027 and February 2028. The equipment is for WAG9, WAG9H, WAP7, and WAP5 electric locomotives. The contract includes comprehensive annual maintenance for three years. Hirect Limited is formerly known as Hind Rectifiers Limited. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under the symbol HIRECT.

Sical Logistics Limited issued a postal ballot notice for resolutions to approve related party transactions with Kanpur Logistics Park Private Limited and Sical Multimodal and Rail Transport Limited. Voting is permitted via remote e-voting from November 13, 2026, to December 12, 2026. Gunina Commercial Private Limited has initiated arbitration against Nikhil Dharamdas Shah regarding a property purchase agreement, with an interim order preventing the sale of the property. The Office of the Development Commissioner MSME invited applications for Implementing Agencies for the Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme Scheme for FY 2026-27.
